g.title: dfa_devops_engineer
g.text: DevOps Engineer, M = (Q, S, d, q0, F)
Arrows show the transitions that fill a slot. The self loops that make d total, section 4.5, are not drawn.
slot 2, cloud provider: AWS or AZURE or GOOGLE_CLOUD
slot 3, CI/CD: GITHUB_ACTIONS or GITLAB_CI_CD or JENKINS
slot 4, infrastructure automation: ANSIBLE or TERRAFORM
